decision.msg: Anchor = the NEWEST bubble's top, not the bottom edge. Widget.Thread.anchor() replaces the bottom pin: growing text never scrolls; the box turns a page only when a bubble starts with under 75% of a box below it, or when a bubble taller than the box grows (tail lands mid-box, half a box at a time). A reader who scrolled up is never moved. Alternative (a), overflow-anchor + pin to bottom on append, rejected: measured 27-38 moves at 400 split because every extra line scrolls every older bubble; the ResizeObserver inside sticky_scroll (ext/Chat) also re-pinned to the bottom on every box resize. Alternative (b), newest always at the top: rejected because it hides the reply you were reading the instant you speak; the 75% headroom keeps it until the page is really full.

log.msg: Change reaches into ext/Chat/Chat.js by one option: sticky_scroll(box, {observe:false}) skips its bottom-only ResizeObserver (default unchanged, so every other chat is untouched). Thread now has its own observer calling anchor(). Also Widget.css overflow-anchor:none, because Chrome scroll anchoring moved the box 50px mid-sentence once.
